name: hover-highlight
title: Hover highlight
description: A grid of cards where one highlight glides to the card under the pointer or keyboard focus.

props.name: items
props.description: The cards, each with a title, a text and an optional href that makes it a link.

a11y.text: Items are links when href is given, so each is a Tab stop with a visible focus ring. Focus moves the highlight like hover does.
A list of items; items without href are plain divs. The highlight is an aria-hidden span.
The highlight uses Motion with reduced motion set to user, so its movement follows the system setting.
